capabilities: Search books by title, author, publisher or ISBN via Google Books or Naver
Create a book note from the selected search result
Fill a template file with book variables (title, authors, publisher, ISBN, cover URL)
Download and save book cover images into the vault
Configure new file location, file name format and service provider
disambiguation: Not a general book catalog browser; the search exists only to create a note in the vault from the selected book's metadata.
extras: Google's free API has rate limits; the README explains how to create and add a Google Cloud API key to bypass them. Naver search setup instructions are on the author's blog, not in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up book metadata online and turn it into a structured book note.

relations.evidence: Use Google Books API to get the book information.
To use Naver Book Search, clientId and clientSecret are required.
Here is the dataview query used in the demo

summary: Book note creator that searches Google Books or Naver by title, author, publisher or ISBN and builds a note from the book's metadata.
